maria_cust_ops: hey team — running into a weird one after we pinned the embeddings model. Our downstream index started rejecting vectors with "embedding_dim_mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024". Only ~1-2% of requests fail but it's enough to break our batch upsert job. pinned model: text-embed-v2@pin-2026-03-10. Happened first around 2026-03-14T21:12Z.

sara_support: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal repro + the API request you're using? batching size, any retries, and the exact error payload would help.

maria_cust_ops: here's a trimmed curl we used (sanitized keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-v2@pin-2026-03-10","inputs":["a","b","c","d"]}'
```
Response we saw intermittently (from client):
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": {
    "message": "embedding_dim_mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024",
    "code": "emb.dim_mismatch"
  }
}
```

bench-bot: automated check against latest canary shows two artifact variants for text-embed-v2: 
```
- text-embed-v2 (base) -> dims=1536
- text-embed-v2-q8h -> dims=1024
```

tom_oncall: high-level suspicion: pinned name resolves to model family but runtime routing allowed fallback to a quantized variant (q8h) that has different vector length. Pinned = logical pin at API layer, but an internal routing rule added last week can route to compatible variants to save cost. That rule should have excluded pinned models.

sara_support: can you confirm if the failing requests share anything? e.g., same region, same batch size, or same request size distribution?

maria_cust_ops: all failing requests are batches of 4-8 small strings (each < 120 chars). Successes are mixed sizes. Region us-west-2. No explicit model_version param in our request.

jaya_mleng: probable repro path: batching + heterogeneous variant pool. If the batch gets split across backends (one shard on base, one on q8h) we end up with vectors of different dims returned in the same response set or in two responses with inconsistent metadata. Repro steps I used locally:
1) Pin logical name to pin-2026-03-10
2) Send 1000 batched requests (batch_size=6) with small inputs to us-west-2
3) ~1.3% of requests returned 1024 vectors and triggered client-side validation errors.

jaya_mleng: logs snippet from runtime routing (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-14T21:12:34Z] request id=abc123 model_requested=text-embed-v2@pin-2026-03-10 -> routed_to=text-embed-v2-q8h instance=x10 region=us-west-2
[2026-03-14T21:12:34Z] request id=abc124 model_requested=text-embed-v2@pin-2026-03-10 -> routed_to=text-embed-v2 instance=x11 region=us-west-2
```

jaya_mleng: root cause: routing policy allowed serving from any compatible variant in the family when pinned at the logical name level. That was intended for non-pinned traffic to improve cost, but a recent change widened the scope and accidentally included pinned names. This produced mixed-dimension responses.

sara_support: immediate mitigation options?

tom_oncall: short-term: re-pin to explicit artifact (include variant suffix) or disable cross-variant routing for that customer. I'll coordinate rollback of the routing change for pinned models.

maria_cust_ops: if we re-pin what exact name should we use?
jaya_mleng: pin to the exact artifact: e.g., "text-embed-v2@artifact-text-embed-v2-20260301" or "text-embed-v2-v1" (the variant that reports dims=1536). We'll share the exact artifact id in DM.

sara_support: thanks. We're doing the rollback now. deploy-bot: please confirm.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: routing-change-2026-03-12 -> rolling back canary -> targets affected: pinned-routing-policy. Started at 2026-03-14T22:05:00Z.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 2026-03-14T22:08:12Z. Health: OK. :white_check_mark:

bench-bot: quick smoke after rollback: 10k batched requests, 0 failures observed. dims all 1536.

maria_cust_ops: confirmed on our side — bulk upserts resumed, errors dropped to 0. Thank you! :raised_hands:

sara_support: filing internal bug RW-6092 to prevent cross-variant serving for pinned model names and to add tests for embedding dim invariants when pinning. Assigning to eng-runtime and ml-eng.

jaya_mleng: plan: 1) enforce routing exclusion for pinned names 2) add invariant check in canary deploy job to fail if artifact family contains mixed-dimension variants 3) add telemetry alert for unexpected embedding_dim changes per model family.

sara_support: leaving this thread open until RW-6092 is closed. Customer says they're unblocked. Will update when bug is fixed.

maria_cust_ops: thanks again — can we get a postmortem once rw-6092 is done?
sara_support: yes, we'll post an incident summary in #incidents when the fix ships.
